appearanceDescription: Choose the theme and language used on this device.

provider.description: Choose the AI provider and model. Used by all projects.

sharing.description: Create a time-limited access token for this project. Callers with the token can read generated documents when results:read is allowed; they cannot access raw CV uploads or private conversation history.
sharing.defaultOff: Sharing stays off until you create a token.
sharing.resultsPrivacy: Generated results may contain personal information. Grant only the capabilities needed.

keyHint: Enter the key again whenever you save. It is stored in the operating system credential store, cleared from this form after saving, and never shown again.
notConfigured: No provider is configured for this project.
saveFailed: We could not save this setting. Check the values and try again.

connection.failed: The saved provider connection failed. Check the configuration and try again.
connection.unavailable: The provider connection is unavailable right now.

tools.description: Enable only the supported Career Ops connector for this project. Availability depends on the local installation.

sharingDefaultOff: Sharing stays off until you create a token.
sharingResultsPrivacy: Generated results may contain personal information. Grant only the capabilities needed.

capability.resultsRead: Read generated results (may contain personal information)
capability.jobsEvaluate: Evaluate job postings (AI evaluation and keyword fit check)
capability.documentsDraft: Draft application documents and follow-up messages
capability.cvTailor: Tailor your CV to a job (saved as a new CV document)
capability.applicationsApply: Prepare application answers from your CV and request that you approve a submission

tokenWarning: This value is shown once. Closing this view discards it; it cannot be recovered.
appliesNow: Changes apply immediately and are stored on this device only.
baseUrlHint: Must use https, except for localhost.
baseUrlHttps: Use an https URL (http is allowed only for localhost).
baseUrlInvalid: Enter a valid URL, for example https://api.example.com/v1.
keyNotNeeded: No API key is needed for {{provider}}.
modelHint: Pick a model from the list or type any model name.
needKeyForModels: Enter the API key first to load the model list.
curlHint: Read in your browser only. The text is never sent or stored, and is cleared after extracting.
curlNothing: No URL, key or model found in this text.
privacyNote: The CV content needed for your requests is sent to the selected provider.
customKeyNote: The key is sent to the Base URL you set.

error.invalid_base_url: The Base URL is not valid or not allowed. Use https, or http only for localhost.
error.provider_models_unavailable: The provider did not return a model list. Type the model name instead.
error.secret_store_unavailable: The system credential store is unavailable, so the key could not be saved.

activeGrantsHint: Tokens issued for this project and their status.
